newsitem.title: USA: Home State breaks covenants from loss.
newsitem.headline: Home State breaks covenants from loss.

text.p: Home State Holdings Inc said on Wednesday that it violated certain financial covenants after the company reported a substantial operating loss for the first quarter.

Home State's net loss brings statuatory surplus in its insurance company subsidiaries to a level approaching regulatory required minimums and that it violated covenants in agreements with its banks and subordinated noteholders, it said.
Home State said it is working with Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette in evaluating alternatives to obtain an infusion of capital or other support necessary for its insurance operations.
